build_I2VGenXLUNet_model: build an I2VGenXLUNet 3D conditional UNet model for image-to-video generation with configurable block types
run_I2VGenXLUNet_forward: run the I2VGenXLUNet forward pass with noisy sample, timestep, fps, and image latents inputs
create_I2VGenXLTransformerTemporalEncode: create an I2VGenXLTransformerTemporalEncoder with self-attention and feed-forward layers for temporal encoding
enable_freeu_I2VGenXLUNet: enable the FreeU mechanism on I2VGenXLUNet upsample blocks with scaling factors s1, s2, b1, b2
fuse_qkv_projections_I2VGenXLUNet: fuse QKV projections in I2VGenXLUNet attention modules for optimized self-attention and cross-attention
